sn12.64:1.2: Cattāro me bhikkhave āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānam ṭhitiyā sambhavesinaṃ vā anuggahāya || || 3

sn12.64:2.1: Kabaliṃkāre ce bhikkhave āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandi atthi taṇhā patiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ virūḷhaṃ || ||

sn12.64:2.3: Yattha atthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti atthi tattha saṅkhārāṇaṃ vuddhi ||
